title: Hidden Order · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Hidden Order · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead secretly arranges three colored papers and covers them. A partner proposes an order; the lead says how many colors are in the correct position, then the partner makes a second proposal. The second proposal matches the hidden order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three colored papers.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Hidden Order, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The second proposal matches the hidden order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The second proposal matches the hidden order.
